senses.gloss: स्मृ (I) vt. or vi. 5P (pres. स्मृणोति) 1. To please, to gratify; 2. to protect, to defend; 3. to live.

स्मृ (II) vt. or vi. 1P (often Atm. in epic poetry) (pp. स्मृत; pres. स्मरति-ते; pass. स्मर्यते; desid. सुस्मूर्षते) 1. To recollect, to call to mind, to bear in mind, to think upon, to be mindful of, स्मरसि सुतनि तस्मिन् पर्वते लक्ष्मणेन Ut.i.; 2. to recite mentally the name of a deity, e.g. प्रातः स्मरामि हृदि संस्फुरदात्मतत्वम्; 3. to record in a Smṛti; 4. to desire, to long for, to remember with regret, (with gen.), कच्चिद्भर्तुः स्मरसि रसिके त्वं हि तस्य प्रियेति Megh.ii.22.With अनु-, call to mind, to remember.With अप-, to forget.With वि-, to forget, अस्मिन्क्षणे विस्मृतं खलु मया Sak.i.With सम्-, to remember, M.iv.149.

स्मृ Caus. (स्मारयति-ते, स्मरयति-ते) 1. to cause to remember, to remind, to call to mind, य एव दुस्मरः कालस्तमेव स्मारिता वयम् Ut.vi.; 2. to give information; 3. to cause to regret; 4. to cause to desire or long for; (in this sense only स्मरयति-ते).With सम्-, to remind, (पातालं) मामद्य संस्मरयतीव भुजंगलोकः Rat.i.

स्मृति f. 1. Recollection, remembrance, memory, स्मृतिमपि न ते यांति क्ष्मापा विना यदनुग्रहम् Rajat.; 2. the body of law (civil and religious) (as op. to श्रुति or revelation), M.ii.6; 3. a law-book; 4. a passage concerning law, a text of Smṛti; 4. understanding; 5. desire.
स्मृति-अंतर n. another law-book.
स्मृति-अपेत a. 1. forgotten; 2. inconsistent with Smṛti; 3. unjust.
स्मृति-उक्त a. prescribed in the codes of law, canonical.
स्मृति-पथ, -विषय m. scope or object of memory; (used with गम् or नी to mean ‘to be deceased’).
स्मृति-पथ, -विषय m. scope or object of memory; (used with गम् or नी to mean ‘to be deceased’).
स्मृति-प्रत्यवमर्ष m. retentiveness of memory, accuracy of recollection.
स्मृति-प्रबंध m. a legal composition or work.
स्मृति-भ्रंश m. loss or failure of memory.
स्मृति-रोध m. temporary interruption of memory, loss of memory.
स्मृति-विभ्रम m. confusion of memory.
स्मृति-विरोध m. 1. opposition to law, illegality, impropriety; 2. disagreement of two or more Smṛtis, तत्र प्रथमं तावत्स्मृतिविरोधमुपन्यस्य परिहरति S.Bh.ii.1.9.
स्मृति-शास्त्र n. 1. a law-book, code, digest; 2. legal science.
स्मृति-शेष a. deceased, defunct (as a person).
स्मृति-शैथिल्य n. failure of memory.
स्मृति-साध्य a. capable of being proved by law.
स्मृति-सिद्ध a. established by law.
स्मृति-हेतु m. a cause of recollection, association of ideas.
